blog_title: 260 GSM vs 240 GSM Plain T-Shirt Wholesale — Is ₹15 Extra Per Piece Worth It for Bulk Printers?
caption:
300 pieces. 3 suppliers. All out of stock. 😬

Boxy fit uses 30-40% more fabric than regular tees — that's 250-260 GSM vs 180 GSM. Suppliers can't predict demand, so stocking boxy blanks is risky for them.

Here's what we learned: order boxy fit 2-3 weeks ahead. And always check samples — some manufacturers cheat on thickness to cut costs.

Save this if you're sourcing your next bulk order 👇
